mapper.insert: INSERT INTO draftsh (employee_no, draft_title, draft_date, draft_completion_time, draft_retention_schedule, draft_state, draft_cost, draft_last_step, draft_current_step, draft_memo) VALUES (#{employeeNo}, #{draftTitle}, #{draftDate}, #{draftCompletionTime}, #{draftRetentionSchedule}, #{draftState}, #{draftCost}, #{draftLastStep}, #{draftCurrentStep}, #{draftMemo});
mapper.select: SELECT e.employee_no, e.employee_name, d.department_no, d.department_name, h.position FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON e.department_no = d.department_no LEFT JOIN human_resource h ON e.employee_no = h.employee_no ORDER BY department_no
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM draftsh WHERE (employee_no = #{empno}) and (${state})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval (draft_no, employee_no, approval_state, approval_step, approval_posible, approval_completion_time, approval_memo) VALUES (#{draftNo}, #{employeeNo}, #{approvalState}, #{approvalStep}, #{approvalPosible}, #{approvalCompletionTime}, #{approvalMemo})
mapper.select: SELECT a.draft_no, a.employee_no, a.approval_state, a.approval_step, a.approval_posible, a.approval_completion_time, a.approval_memo, hr.position, e.employee_name, d.department_name FROM approval a LEFT JOIN human_resource hr ON a.employee_no = hr.employee_no LEFT JOIN employee e ON a.employee_no = e.employee_no LEFT JOIN department d ON e.department_no = d.department_no WHERE a.draft_no = #{draftNo}
